content: The concentration of the substance in the blood is slightly higher compared to its concentration in the urine. Swallow the tablet whole once daily. Take the medication every day at approximately the same time to ensure a consistent 24-hour interval between doses. Store the medication at a controlled room temperature of 25°C (77°F). Temporary excursions are permitted within a range of 15°C to 30°C (59°F to 86°F).
